title: Machine learning
tagline: Derive it, code it from scratch, then compare with the library.
intro: Model-first: each lesson starts from a model you can picture and pulls in the probability, statistics and calculus it needs as a detour. Every result is derived in full, with figures you can move. The path runs from a straight line to diffusion models, large language models and AlphaZero.

1.title: Learning from data
1.blurb: Linear regression, gradient descent and the delta rule, logistic regression.

2.title: Making models honest
2.blurb: Generalisation, regularisation, softmax, stochastic optimisation, evaluation.

3.title: Trees and boosting
3.blurb: A side branch: decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting.

4.title: Neural networks
4.blurb: Neurons and MLPs, backpropagation, training deep networks.

5.title: Deep architectures
5.blurb: CNNs, ResNets, RNNs, embeddings, attention, transformers, ViT and CLIP.

6.title: Generative models
6.blurb: VAEs, GANs, diffusion, score matching and guidance.

7.title: Large language models
7.blurb: Tokenisation, pretraining and scaling laws, alignment, efficiency, reasoning.

8.title: Reinforcement learning
8.blurb: Markov chains, bandits, MDPs and Bellman, dynamic programming, TD learning, Q-learning and DQN, policy gradients, PPO, MCTS and AlphaZero.

9.title: Reading the papers
9.blurb: A guided tour of the landmark papers behind every stage.

10.title: Math toolkit
10.blurb: Linear algebra, matrix calculus, probability, information theory, optimisation, sampling.
10.label: Toolkit

11.title: Problems and assignments
11.blurb: A problem set per stage with worked solutions, and autograded programming assignments.
11.label: Practice
